dataset: Objectron annotated-box crops of project COLMAP sparse clouds
split_policy: This manifest contains only the official train index. Keep it separate from manifests built from other source splits; never split frames from the same source video across train and test.
limitations: Accepted samples are sparse SfM crops constrained by annotated boxes, not dense or watertight surfaces.
Camera-center Sim(3) residual is not an independent metric geometry accuracy test.
No independent official test split is present.
